paragraphs: Lily got an email from her pen pal Grace on Tuesday evening. The subject was "My apartment." Grace put a plan of her home in the email. "Dear Lily, Thank you for the photos of your house. Now I will tell you about my home.

I live in an apartment on the top floor. There is a lift, so I never walk up the steps. At the front door, you walk into the living room. It has a big sofa with four yellow cushions. The room is bright, and it has a big window. We watch television there after dinner. There is a small table with a telephone on it. My dad likes the old telephone, and he uses it every evening.

The kitchen is on the left of the living room. It has a white fridge, an oven, and a table made of wood. Mom cooks dinner while I do my homework at the table. The oven is new, and Mom is very happy with it. The kitchen smells wonderful in the evening. Have you ever made a cake in an oven? We have just made one for my little brother. He ate three pieces, and he wanted more!

The bathroom is small, but it is very clean. There is a metal shelf for the towels. There is also a green soap next to the sink. My room is at the end of the hall. It has a bed, a desk, and a shelf made of wood. There is a window next to my desk. At night, I can see many lights from it. My violin is on the shelf. My parents' room is across the hall.
What does your room look like? Is it bigger than mine? I want to know all about your home. Please send me a plan of your house, too. I have drawn mine for you. Best wishes, Grace"
text.summary: Lily gets an email from her pen pal Grace in Singapore. Grace tells Lily about the rooms and the furniture in her apartment.
